instrument: Fort Worth 90-day data center moratorium (process initiated Aug 11, 2026)
summary: Council voted unanimously Aug 11 to begin the state-required process for a 90-day moratorium on new data centers, extendable to 180 days under Texas law; not in effect until hearings and votes are complete. A final vote is reported for around February, running to May 17. Projects with zoning applications filed beforehand are reported exempt. A Data Center and Infrastructure Commission is expected to report Nov 3.

source.citation: Fort Worth Report; KERA; NBC 5; DCD; The Business Press (Aug 12-14, 2026)

notes: Final adoption requires a three-fourths council majority, with a vote 12 days after the first hearing and a second vote 28 days later (Fort Worth Report). CONFLICT on timing: the city said in July final action would not be considered until December; NBC 5 later reported February.

next.event: Fort Worth Data Center and Infrastructure Commission report expected
